$sources: MNBC 2020 Part 3 seismic design in the IBC / ASCE 7 form: mapped SS and S1, site coefficients Fa and Fv, SDS = 2/3 Fa SS, SD1 = 2/3 Fv S1 (the ASCE 7-05 to 7-16 tables), site classes A-F by the average shear wave velocity

clauses.siteCoefficients: MNBC 2020 Part 3 (site coefficients Fa, Fv; ASCE 7-05 Tables 11.4-1, 11.4-2 form)

SA.description: Site class A: hard rock (vs above 1524 m/s)

SC.description: Site class C: very dense soil and soft rock (vs 366-762 m/s)

SD.description: Site class D: stiff soil (vs 183-366 m/s)

SE.description: Site class E: soft clay soil (vs below 183 m/s)

SF.description: Site class F: soils needing a site response analysis

sources.designSpectrum.siteCoefficients: MNBC 2020 Part 3 in the ASCE 7-05 form: Fa by SS (0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0, 1.25 g) and Fv by S1 (0.1 to 0.5 g) for site classes A-E, linear between, the end values outside (ASCE 7-05 Tables 11.4-1 and 11.4-2); site class F needs a site response analysis (the parent's siteSpecificStudy: read as class E meanwhile)
sources.siteClasses: MNBC 2020 Part 3 site classes A-F by the average shear wave velocity of the top 30 m (ASCE 7-05 Table 20.3-1: 5000, 2500, 1200, 600 ft/s = 1524, 762, 366, 183 m/s)
